title: Construct the Minimum Bitwise Array I
summary: Given an array of n prime numbers, construct an array ans of length n where for each index i, the bitwise OR of ans[i] and ans[i] + 1 equals the corresponding prime number in the input array.
statement: Given an array of n prime numbers, construct an array ans of length n where for each index i, the bitwise OR of ans[i] and ans[i] + 1 equals the corresponding prime number in the input array. Minimize each ans[i] value. If no valid ans[i] can be found, set ans[i] to -1.
constraints: For each prime value p, find the smallest nonnegative x such that x bitwise-OR (x+1) equals p.
Return -1 for a value with no solution.
Produce one answer for every input value in the same order.
reference_solution:
def construct_minimum_bitwise_array(nums):
    answer=[]
    for value in nums:
        if value==2:answer.append(-1);continue
        bit=1
        while value&bit:bit<<=1
        answer.append(value-(bit>>1))
    return answer

hints: Two is the only even prime and has no valid predecessor.
For an odd value, locate the first zero above its trailing run of one bits.
Clear the highest one in that trailing run.
This creates the required carry in x+1 and clears the largest possible bit, yielding the minimum x.

tests.explanation: Two has no solution; the minimum values for 3, 5, and 7 are 1, 4, and 3.
Nine OR ten is eleven, while twelve OR thirteen is thirteen.
